title: Norway Explorer Tour | Flam Railway, Fjords & Iconic Routes
highlights: Discover Norway's beauty on this tour from Oslo to Bergen and experience scenic train rides, Hurtigruten cruise, fjords, and charming towns like Ålesund.
Ride the Flam Railway for a thrilling journey through Norway's landscapes, cascading waterfalls, majestic mountains, and picturesque valleys on this iconic rail route.
Sail through Norway's coastline on a Hurtigruten cruise to witness awe-inspiring fjords, charming coastal towns, and the magical Northern Lights.
Explore Trondheim's rich history, stunning architecture including Nidaros Cathedral, picturesque waterfront, vibrant cultural scene, and outdoor activities like hiking and skiing.
Experience Norway in a Nutshell for unparalleled natural beauty, fjords, mountains, waterfalls, scenic train rides like Flam Railway and charming villages like Bergen.
overview:
About the tour:
With breathtaking fjords, stunning mountain ranges, quaint coastal towns and rugged coastline, Norway is indeed a place that came straight out of an artist's imagination. This 10-day tour to Norway will give you an experience out of the ordinary, it starts and end in the capital city, Oslo and takes you all the way to Bergen with an experience to ride one of the most scenic train journeys in the world. Your astonishment wouldn't cease here, wait till aboard the Hurtigruten Cruise from Bergen to Trondheim revealing breathtaking vistas among the vast fjords and mountains and passes by some of the most beautiful attractions on the way including the famous Geirangerfjord and Ålesund. From sailing amidst the fjords and riding the beautiful rails to exploring the quaint towns of Bergen and Trondheim, this tour will give you an experience that will be etched in your memories for a lifetime.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrive in Oslo
days.desc: Arrive in Oslo, Norway's vibrant capital. You will be transferred to your hotel, check-in and relax for a while. Later, spend the evening exploring the city's attractions like Viking Ship Museum, Oslo City Hall, Munch Museum and more. Later, dine at the local restaurants exploring Norwegian cuisine. Post the fun, head back to your hotel for an overnight stay and a good sleep to prepare for the upcoming days of adventure.

days.title: Train Journey from Oslo to Flam
days.desc: Wake up energised to embark on the scenic Norway in a Nutshell tour. Head to the Oslo station to catch the Bergensbanen train passing by quaint villages like Geilo and Gol before reaching the Myrdal station. From there, hop on the Flåm Railway, crossing the curvy and steep valleys and cascading waterfalls along the Aurlandsfjord and UNESCO-protected Nærøyfjord. Finally, arrive in the village of Flåm for an overnight stay.

items.title: The Flam Railway Experience on a Shared basis

days.title: Arrival in Bergen via Gudvagen
days.desc: Check out and head to the harbour to board a scenic 2-hour fjord cruise to Gudvangen. As you sail through the narrowest arm of the Sognefjord, Nærøyfjord, witness the mighty peaks, tumbling waterfalls and small farms dotting the mountainsides. Next, hop on a bus to Voss and later take the Bergensbanen train to Bergen. Upon arrival, check-into your hotel and you can visit Bryggen, KODE Museum or Mount Floyen for the city view. Afterwards, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Scenic Cruise Ride From Flam to Gudvangen on a Shared basis
Transfer in AC Shuttle Bus
items.desc: 1 X AC Shuttle Bus will be Provided

items.title: Scenic Train Ride to Bergen on a Shared basis

days.title: Leisure day at Bergen
days.desc: Wake up to a new day in Bergen and get on a journey to explore the capital of Fjords at your own pace. Take a leisurely walk along the streets or visit the famous landmarks, the choice is yours. You can also hop on a classic sightseeing tour bus and enjoy a panoramic view of all the attractions. From the Bergen Aquarium to the Frederiksberg Fortress, Jekteviken and more with an on-board audio commentary. After an exciting day of exploration, head back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Sail through Hurtigruten Cruise
days.desc: Post check-out, get ready for an unforgettable cruise experience. In the evening, embark on a journey aboard the Hurtigruten cruise from Bergen to Trondheim. Check into your cabin and cruise along Norway's coastline, passing majestic fjords, charming coastal villages, and snow-capped mountains. Also witness, the UNESCO-listed Geirangerfjord in summer or the enchanting Hjørundfjord in autumn. Experience a night surrounded by Norway's natural beauty on board with an overnight stay in the cruise.

items.title: Hurtigruten Cruise from Bergen to Trondheim on a Shared basis

days.title: Cruise to Molde
days.desc: Wake up to mesmerizing views from your cabin as you continue on the coastal voyage. Sail through Nordfjord near Torvik while passing by the Western Cape en route to the Ålesund, for its Art Nouveau architecture and the Atlantic Park. Then, marvel at the UNESCO-listed Geirangerfjord with the iconic Seven Sisters Waterfall and discover the hidden gem of Hjørundfjord, situated in the Sunnmør Alps. Finally, end your day in Molde, the "City of Roses" and head to your cabin for an overnight stay.

items.title: Hurtigruten Cruise from Bergen to Trondheim on a Shared basis

days.title: Disembark at Trondheim | Day at Leisure
days.desc: In the morning, disembark from the cruise at Trondheim and get transferred to your hotel. After that, check-in and enjoy the day at your leisure In the afternoon, you can take a walk around the beautiful town of Trondheim and visit the idyllic neighbourhood of Bakklandet, which is full of history and culture. You can also visit the Nidaros Cathedral, the Ringve Museum and Gardens, Munkholmen, and the Old Town Bridge. Finally, head back to the hotel for an overnight stay in Trondheim.

items.title: Check-in at Deluxe hotel
items.hotel: Radisson Blu Royal Garden Hotel, Trondheim

days.title: Train Journey from Trondheim to Oslo
days.desc: Check-out and transfer to the Trondheim station for a train journey to Oslo, a visual treat with breathtaking views & landscapes. En route, pass by the Gudbrandsdalen valley and the Dovre mountain plateau, home to around 300 wild musk oxen. The journey concludes with a steep, curvy descent to the lowlands of Oslo. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and later, you can explore the town’s Bygdøy, the Kon Tiki Museum and many more. Later, head back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Scenic Train Ride from Trondheim to Oslo on a Shared basis

days.title: Oslo Discovery Tour
days.desc: Head to Haakon VIIs gate 1, 0161 Oslo, for a transfer to dive into the history of Oslo city's iconic landmarks like the Akershus Fortress and the Royal Palace. Later, continue walking along the Oslofjord waterfront, enjoying the views from the top of the Holmenkollen Ski Jump and the Oslo Opera House, a masterpiece of contemporary design. Conclude the day with local cafes & restaurants for culinary delights. Finally, transfer back to the drop point and head to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Oslo City Sightseeing Tour on a Shared basis

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: The day marks the end of your Norwegian tour! Check-out and get transferred to the Oslo Airport to catch your flight back home with a ton load of memories to share with your loved ones.
